mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.1%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns in low-rate periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% signals a weak labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 8.0, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts (HOUST < 700) and retail sales (RSAFS < 405000) indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST < 700 and RSAFS < 405000 fails to produce negative returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 225) typically prompts central bank tightening, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 225 fails to correlate with negative returns in > 60% of cases, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03.

failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 fails to predict negative returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is negative.
